from typing import Optional, List
from datetime import datetime
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status, Header, BackgroundTasks, Query
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select, func

from app.database import get_db
from app.auth import get_current_user
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.task import Task, TaskGroup
from app.services.task import TaskService
from app.schemas.task import (
    TaskCreate,
    TaskResponse,
    TaskGroupCreate,
    TaskGroupResponse,
)


router = APIRouter(prefix="/v1beta/tasks", tags=["Task API"])


@router.post("", response_model=TaskResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_task(
    request: TaskCreate,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    field_basis: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="field-basis"),
    sync: bool = Query(True, description="Execute synchronously (default) or in background")
) -> TaskResponse:
    service = TaskService(db)
    task = await service.create_task(int(current_user.id), request)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if sync:
        await service.execute_task(task)
        task = await service.get_task(str(task.task_id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    else:
        task_id_str = str(task.task_id)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        
        async def execute_task_in_background():
            from app.database import async_session_maker
            async with async_session_maker() as bg_db:  # type: ignore[misc]
                bg_service = TaskService(bg_db)
                bg_task = await bg_service.get_task(task_id_str)
                if bg_task and str(bg_task.status) == "pending":  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    await bg_service.execute_task(bg_task)
        
        background_tasks.add_task(execute_task_in_background)
    
    assert task is not None
    response = service.format_task_response(task)
    
    if field_basis and task.field_basis:  # type: ignore[truthy-bool]
        requested_fields = set(field_basis.split(","))
        filtered_basis = {k: v for k, v in response.field_basis.items() if k in requested_fields}
        response.field_basis = filtered_basis
    
    return response


@router.get("", response_model=dict)
async def list_tasks(
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of tasks to return"),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of tasks to skip"),
    status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="status", description="Filter by status: pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled"),
    processor: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by processor"),
    mode: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by mode: schema, auto, text")
) -> dict:
    query = select(Task).where(Task.user_id == current_user.id, Task.group_id == None)
    count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Task).where(Task.user_id == current_user.id, Task.group_id == None)
    
    if status_filter:
        valid_statuses = ["pending", "running", "completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
        if status_filter not in valid_statuses:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"Invalid status filter. Must be one of: {', '.join(valid_statuses)}"
            )
        query = query.where(Task.status == status_filter)
        count_query = count_query.where(Task.status == status_filter)
    
    if processor:
        query = query.where(Task.processor == processor)
        count_query = count_query.where(Task.processor == processor)
    
    if mode:
        valid_modes = ["schema", "auto", "text"]
        if mode not in valid_modes:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"Invalid mode filter. Must be one of: {', '.join(valid_modes)}"
            )
        query = query.where(Task.mode == mode)
        count_query = count_query.where(Task.mode == mode)
    
    count_result = await db.execute(count_query)
    total = count_result.scalar() or 0
    
    query = query.order_by(Task.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(limit)
    result = await db.execute(query)
    tasks = result.scalars().all()
    
    service = TaskService(db)
    task_responses = [service.format_task_response(task) for task in tasks]
    
    return {
        "tasks": [t.model_dump() for t in task_responses],
        "total": total,
        "limit": limit,
        "offset": offset,
        "has_more": offset + len(tasks) < total
    }


@router.get("/{task_id}", response_model=TaskResponse)
async def get_task(
    task_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    field_basis: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="field-basis")
) -> TaskResponse:
    service = TaskService(db)
    task = await service.get_task(task_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not task:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task '{task_id}' not found"
        )
    
    response = service.format_task_response(task)
    
    if field_basis and response.field_basis:
        requested_fields = set(field_basis.split(","))
        filtered_basis = {k: v for k, v in response.field_basis.items() if k in requested_fields}
        response.field_basis = filtered_basis
    
    return response


@router.delete("/{task_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def delete_task(
    task_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
) -> dict:
    service = TaskService(db)
    task = await service.get_task(task_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not task:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task '{task_id}' not found"
        )
    
    original_status = task.status
    
    if str(task.status) == "running":  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        task.status = "cancelled"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.error_message = "Task cancelled by user"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()  # type: ignore[assignment]
        await db.commit()
        return {
            "task_id": task_id,
            "status": "cancelled",
            "previous_status": original_status,
            "message": "Running task has been cancelled"
        }
    
    if str(task.status) == "pending":  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        task.status = "cancelled"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.error_message = "Task cancelled before execution"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()  # type: ignore[assignment]
        await db.commit()
        return {
            "task_id": task_id,
            "status": "cancelled",
            "previous_status": original_status,
            "message": "Pending task has been cancelled"
        }
    
    return {
        "task_id": task_id,
        "status": task.status,
        "previous_status": original_status,
        "message": f"Task with status '{task.status}' cannot be cancelled but has been acknowledged"
    }


@router.post("/{task_id}/retry", response_model=TaskResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def retry_task(
    task_id: str,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    sync: bool = Query(True, description="Execute synchronously or in background")
) -> TaskResponse:
    service = TaskService(db)
    task = await service.get_task(task_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not task:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task '{task_id}' not found"
        )
    
    if task.status not in ["failed", "cancelled"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Can only retry failed or cancelled tasks. Current status: {task.status}"
        )
    
    task.status = "pending"  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.error_message = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.started_at = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.completed_at = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.output = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.output_text = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.field_basis = {}  # type: ignore[assignment]
    task.credits_used = 0.0  # type: ignore[assignment]
    await db.commit()
    
    if sync:
        await service.execute_task(task)
        task = await service.get_task(str(task.task_id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    else:
        async def execute_retry_in_background():
            from app.database import async_session_maker
            async with async_session_maker() as bg_db:  # type: ignore[misc]
                bg_service = TaskService(bg_db)
                bg_task = await bg_service.get_task(task_id)
                if bg_task and str(bg_task.status) == "pending":  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    await bg_service.execute_task(bg_task)
        
        background_tasks.add_task(execute_retry_in_background)
    
    assert task is not None
    return service.format_task_response(task)


@router.post("/groups", response_model=TaskGroupResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_task_group(
    request: TaskGroupCreate,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
) -> TaskGroupResponse:
    service = TaskService(db)
    group = await service.create_task_group(int(current_user.id), request)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    group_id_str = str(group.group_id)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    async def execute_group_in_background():
        from app.database import async_session_maker
        async with async_session_maker() as bg_db:  # type: ignore[misc]
            bg_service = TaskService(bg_db)
            bg_group = await bg_service.get_task_group(group_id_str)
            if bg_group:
                await bg_service.execute_task_group(bg_group)
    
    background_tasks.add_task(execute_group_in_background)
    
    return service.format_group_response(group)


@router.get("/groups/{group_id}", response_model=TaskGroupResponse)
async def get_task_group(
    group_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
) -> TaskGroupResponse:
    service = TaskService(db)
    group = await service.get_task_group(group_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not group:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task group '{group_id}' not found"
        )
    
    return service.format_group_response(group)


@router.delete("/groups/{group_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def cancel_task_group(
    group_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
) -> dict:
    service = TaskService(db)
    group = await service.get_task_group(group_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not group:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task group '{group_id}' not found"
        )
    
    if group.status not in ["pending", "running"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Cannot cancel group with status '{group.status}'"
        )
    
    original_status = group.status
    group.status = "cancelled"  # type: ignore[assignment]
    group.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()  # type: ignore[assignment]
    
    result = await db.execute(
        select(Task).where(
            Task.group_id == group.id,
            Task.status.in_(["pending", "running"])
        )
    )
    pending_tasks = result.scalars().all()
    
    cancelled_count = 0
    for task in pending_tasks:
        task.status = "cancelled"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.error_message = "Group cancelled by user"  # type: ignore[assignment]
        task.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()  # type: ignore[assignment]
        cancelled_count += 1
    
    group.pending_count = 0  # type: ignore[assignment]
    group.running_count = 0  # type: ignore[assignment]
    
    await db.commit()
    
    return {
        "group_id": group_id,
        "status": "cancelled",
        "previous_status": original_status,
        "cancelled_tasks": cancelled_count,
        "message": f"Task group and {cancelled_count} pending tasks have been cancelled"
    }


@router.get("/groups/{group_id}/tasks", response_model=List[TaskResponse])
async def get_group_tasks(
    group_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="status", description="Filter by status"),
    limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0)
) -> List[TaskResponse]:
    service = TaskService(db)
    group = await service.get_task_group(group_id, int(current_user.id))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    
    if not group:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Task group '{group_id}' not found"
        )
    
    query = select(Task).where(Task.group_id == group.id)
    
    if status_filter:
        valid_statuses = ["pending", "running", "completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
        if status_filter not in valid_statuses:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"Invalid status filter. Must be one of: {', '.join(valid_statuses)}"
            )
        query = query.where(Task.status == status_filter)
    
    query = query.order_by(Task.created_at).offset(offset).limit(limit)
    result = await db.execute(query)
    tasks = result.scalars().all()
    
    return [service.format_task_response(task) for task in tasks]
